sources.use: XeTeX uses pdfsavepos/pdflastxpos/pdflastypos; Unicode and group-delimited filenames.
Read-only actual shipped index after discard decision, and physical background picture placement.
Included chapters use separate auxiliary files; main aux alone cannot establish convergence.
Recorder captures opened input/output paths; jobname controls the fls basename.
The explicit opentype fonts and truetype fonts format names match the existing Lua font lookup; no shell quoting is required in argument arrays.

status: Primary API references inspected; native adapter and convergence gates remain unrun.
